answer: Slow vesting by account age: an agent's rewards and vote weight grow only as its history ages, like timber seasoning, and early earnings stay locked for months. A swarm of fresh fakes starts as a cold ember with almost no say, so an attacker must keep each one doing honest work for a long time before it counts. That turns a cheap burst of identities into a slow, costly commitment that leaves a record as hard to fake as carved marble.
